Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnRecoveryDoseHo: Sunburn dose recovery per sheltered hour
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableWorldEmitters: Enable dropped and placed world lights
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableAutomaticDiscov: Builds a bounded catalog and review queue. Discovery never automatically grants compatibility.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableColoredLightRen: Required for red, colored, and violet UV light to appear with the registered emitted color.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableAttachmentGeome: Straight belt lights point down; verified angle-headed lights point outward from their attachment side.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableWorldEmitters_t: Enable dropped/placed registered lights and explicit fixture adapters. Disabling stops their output and billing while retaining intended activation; carried lights and native fixtures are separate.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableClothingSunProt: Covered body regions reduce natural UV dose. Holes expose the affected region; overlapping layers do not double coverage.
Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnClothingProtec: Fraction of natural UV blocked by intact clothing over each covered body region. This gameplay value is not a measured fabric UPF rating.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableLasers_tooltip: Render registered weapon lasers while aiming. Presentation only; no damage, accuracy or battery changes.
Sandbox_lightWorks_LaserRangeMultiplier_: Scale the visible aiming ray within the loaded optical tracing budget.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableLaserBeams_tool: Also draw a presentation beam line. Disabled by default; the aiming dot remains visible.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableBurnout_tooltip: Apply lifetime wear to active player-owned bulbs. Disabling retains saved wear; native fixture burnout is separate.
Sandbox_lightWorks_BulbLifetimeMultiplie: Multiply registered inventory bulb lifetimes. Higher values make bulbs last longer.
Sandbox_lightWorks_ServiceTimeMultiplier: Multiply the duration of registered bulb removal and installation actions.
Sandbox_lightWorks_RequireServiceTools_t: Require a compatible maintenance tool for lights whose profile specifies one.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableSpawnBulbConfig: Apply registered tactical bulb distributions when supported lights are created.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableSunburn_tooltip: Accumulate server-owned natural UV dose, sunburn severity and recovery. Existing dose is retained while disabled.
Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnDoseMultiplier: Scale incoming natural UV dose after protection. Artificial UV does not cause this sunburn model.
Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnFirstDegreeDos: Peak-sun dose-hours before severity begins. Timing is provisional and needs play calibration.
Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnMaximumDoseHou: Peak-sun dose-hours for maximum severity. Must exceed onset; invalid ordering is corrected.
Sandbox_lightWorks_SunburnRecoveryDoseHo: Dose-hours recovered per known sheltered hour. Unknown exposure or protection never counts as shelter.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableLowBatteryFlick: Use read-only charge state for deterministic low-charge visual flicker. This does not change energy demand.
Sandbox_lightWorks_LowBatteryFlickerThre: Known remaining charge fraction at or below which visual flicker begins.
Sandbox_lightWorks_LowBatteryFlickerPeri: Length of the flicker cycle in real milliseconds, independent of accelerated game time.
Sandbox_lightWorks_LowBatteryFlickerMini: Cycle fraction spent dark when charge first reaches the flicker threshold.
Sandbox_lightWorks_LowBatteryFlickerMaxi: Maximum dark fraction near empty. Values below the initial dark fraction are corrected.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableLightPatterns_t: Allow registered pattern changes and output. Disabled patterns retain selection and use steady demand.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableWaterUVIntegrat: Register a server-only Water treatment pulse. Disabled by default. Requires complete, confirmed UVC exposure at a placed water container; ordinary Nightfall UVA bulbs do not qualify. Not a real disinfection guarantee.
Sandbox_lightWorks_WaterUVMinimumIntensi: Minimum confirmed local UVC in Spectrum gameplay units for a treatment pulse. Unknown geometry and windows fail closed.
Sandbox_lightWorks_WaterUVMaximumTurbidi: Reject treatment above this normalized turbidity. UV does not remove particles, chemicals or salinity.
Sandbox_lightWorks_WaterUVBiologicalRedu: Fraction removed from the biological gameplay axis by one accepted treatment operation. No effect on other quality axes and no elapsed-dose guarantee.
Sandbox_lightWorks_EnableNativeModelAlig: Apply native yaw only to models with a registered calibration. Off by default; per-model rendering and multiplayer need validation.
Sandbox_lightWorks_OpticalDeviceLootMult: Weights for Spectrum specialist devices and replacement bulbs in medical and garden storage. Zero disables new rolls; existing items remain.
Sandbox_lightWorks_WaterUVTreatmentSecon: Native timed-action duration. The server rechecks power, UVC exposure, water quality and reach on completion; biological reduction is provisional gameplay tuning.
